Start with the expanded examples. Open further examples for options and alternative R approaches.

estimates

Extract one-row model fit statistics

Stata 

estimates stats

R stats 

data.frame(N = stats::nobs(fit), logLik = as.numeric(stats::logLik(fit)), df = attr(stats::logLik(fit), "df"), AIC = stats::AIC(fit), BIC = stats::BIC(fit))

Differs from Stata Extracts model N, maximized log likelihood, likelihood parameter count, AIC and BIC from a fitted likelihood model; Gaussian df includes residual scale.

Stata reference · R reference

etable

Create a tidy coefficient table with uncertainty

Stata 

etable, cstat(_r_b) cstat(_r_se)

R broom 

broom::tidy(fit,conf.int=TRUE)

Fixed workflow. Workflow alternative returning an R table; it does not reproduce Stata table formatting.
